reading: Safety of one-hour rule-out is well estimated where it was studied (claim c1), and a comparable district hospital cut time in the department by about three hours (claim c2). The benefit runs through the proportion ruled out, which is much lower in older patients and kidney disease (claim c4), and through reliable sample timing, which fails often at peak times (claim c3). The laboratory's turnaround and the phlebotomy workflow are therefore as important as the thresholds.
